description: This file defines the 'DropDownBrowser' class, a part of the SuiteCRM project. It provides functionality to generate a list of dropdown options by filtering application list strings, excluding restricted dropdowns, for editing purposes in the module builder interface.

classes.name: DropDownBrowser
classes.description: A class that handles the retrieval and display of dropdown options available for editing within the SuiteCRM module builder.

methods.name: getNodes
methods.description: Generates an array of dropdown options excluding restricted ones, formatted for the module builder UI.
